title: Common-multiplier 91 obstruction for binary Legendre pairs of length 115
claim: There is no binary Legendre pair of length 115 for which 91 belongs to the multiplier group of both sequences.
equivalent_normalized_claim: After independent cyclic shifts, there is no length-115 binary Legendre pair whose two sequences are both fixed by decimation by 91.
scope: This excludes only the common-multiplier-91 symmetry class. It does not resolve unrestricted existence of binary Legendre pairs of length 115.
